ns2:course.label: Engineering Properties of Food Materials
ns2:course.description: Physical properties of foods and biological materials; properties relating to equipment design and the sensing and control of food processes; thermal, electromagnetic radiation, rheological, and other mechanical properties. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Restricted to Grainger Engineering Seniors or Graduate students.
